title: Corrected move cards and clearer saving
summary: Move data follows the released projectile fixes, and save instructions now explain manual cloud uploads.
changes: Recomputed the corrected homing and bouncing projectile counts and spread; removed the old active-bug notices.
Updated Save, co-op, mobile aiming and leaderboard eligibility help for game build d2dfaee739.
Added all 14 permanent upgrade costs, totalling 40,400 coins per partner, within the existing evolution guide.
Added mobile button layout, account recovery and offline-version explanations.

title: More moves. Clearer partner choices.
summary: Compare the expanded move pool and our revised Solo recommendations before your next run.
changes: All 103 move cards, 97 evolution recipes and 966 partner pools now match the checked game build.
Level-up explains the single-type bonus and the 400-coin Starting move upgrade.
Solo recommendations now use S through D. D remains empty rather than assigning weak grades without a basis.
Rankings and Tier List use eight official top-50 boards captured on 20 October 2026, with each mode and period kept separate.
Play opens the official game in a new tab, following the updated official-site restriction.
Level-up now distinguishes twelve projectile-count upgrade descriptions from their current one-shot behavior.
Guides and FAQ add co-op connection checks, pending-save help and steps to check a missing shiny unlock.
Leaderboard dates, partner frequencies and complete Group lineups now follow the new snapshot; the capture time is not a claim about the game build used by each run.
Solo recommendations cover all 109 species in the latest saved boards. Earlier assessments remain on file when a partner leaves the captured top 50.
The rules check now follows game build 1afa081e93. The co-op safety patch leaves the reviewed move values and projectile-count caveats unchanged.

title: Less searching. More playing.
summary: A more compact homepage, clearer guide cards and a player title that stays above the game.
changes: Homepage shortcuts and featured guides now use tighter layouts and a wider variety of Pokémon artwork.
Guide cards use one cover image, with three cards across on desktop.
The Play page keeps its title visible after the game launches.
Rankings now show saved official survival records for Solo and Group across four periods.
Updated partner stats and all 65 move cards for physical and special attacks.
Guide saving instructions now distinguish local progress from a completed cloud upload.

title: Original animations and clearer card choices
summary: Original collection animations and shiny effects accompany a move library organized by partner.
changes: The Level-up page lets you choose from all 966 partners and inspect their move pools.
Boss rewards, held items and Bond explanations are grouped alongside the upgrade cards.
The Tier List Maker supports dragging between rows and scrolling during a drag.
Builds and Sources were retired; guide and card links lead to the remaining pages.
